sources.license_evidence: LICENSE file fetched from upstream; README links to LICENSE
sources.capability: repository metadata + depth-1 root tree + README → synthetic coding prompt

sources.note: Exact repository/path and commit must be identified from the in-progress implementation before admission.

hypothesis.statement: For matched public repositories and a fixed AI-agent configuration, the in-progress internal GitReverse implementation may produce more complete, source-grounded and implementation-useful reconstruction prompts than upstream GitReverse, with different latency, cost and maintenance trade-offs.
hypothesis.null: The internal implementation does not improve the pre-registered reconstruction-quality outcomes over upstream GitReverse.
hypothesis.threshold: A candidate is eligible for promotion only when all material factual claims are source-attributed, the unsupported factual claim rate is zero on the held-out set, and the blind rubric score improves without exceeding the predeclared cost ceiling.

assignment.unit: randomized treatment order within each repository_id × replicate block

design.replication: 8 frozen repositories × 3 treatments × 3 repetitions = 72 planned observations; independent gold annotations are evaluation references, not treatment runs.
design.unit_of_observation: one repository under one reconstruction treatment and repetition = one EXPERIMENT record
design.stopping: Complete the frozen 72-run cohort. Retain all failed, blocked and missing observations. Any source, corpus, prompt, rubric or treatment change creates a new design version.

tasks.contract: reconstruct user purpose, audience, feature set and setup from frozen repository evidence
reconstruct purpose and explicit unknowns without filling gaps from inference
reconstruct architecture, routes, data flow and component boundaries
reconstruct public API, usage contract, extension points and behavioral constraints
produce a scoped implementation brief with requirements, constraints and validation plan
separate observed behavior, documented intent and unknowns across inconsistent sources
identify language/runtime boundaries and preserve source-backed implementation details
pin the snapshot and distinguish current state from historical or planned capabilities

execution_environment.agent: same fixed provider/model@version, system prompt hash, tool manifest hash, role and instance_key for both AI treatments; record exact identity before dispatch
execution_environment.inputs: same frozen commit, README, root tree, and any declared source-depth extension for all treatments
execution_environment.runner: same pinned Linux image and resource limits; exact digest required before execution
execution_environment.credentials: use identical least-privilege public-read access; redact credentials and exclude secrets from fixtures
execution_environment.cache: cold and warm runs separated; primary comparison uses the predeclared cold-start protocol

outcomes.quality_gate: Every material factual claim must cite a frozen source location; unsupported factual claim rate must be zero on the independent held-out set; unknowns must remain explicit.
outcomes.analysis: Report paired per-repository effects, medians, dispersion and confidence intervals. Preserve source coverage, correctness, usefulness, cost and latency as separate outcomes; do not collapse them into one opaque score.

siglary.rule: Promote to a randomized factor only if the internal implementation exposes a stable on/off switch on the same source revision. Otherwise record Siglary version, notation profile and adapter boundary as treatment attributes and create a separate cohort for a true ablation.

comparability.primary_comparison: Upstream GitReverse versus the internal implementation on identical frozen repository evidence.
comparability.baseline: Deterministic structured extraction baseline reports metadata, README facts and tree facts without LLM synthesis; it calibrates added value from generation.
comparability.exclusions: Do not compare repository-reconstruction scores with Rust hot-path runtime outcomes. Do not treat repo-history narrative or session-provenance reconstruction systems as equivalent GitReverse treatments without an explicit contract mapping.

automation.requirement: Use existing DoE Actions surfaces; dispatch the frozen cohort, randomize within blocks, emit one canonical EXPERIMENT.schema.json record per executed run, preserve append-only records and generate SUMMARY.json.
automation.authority: Existing DoE family, GitHub Actions, proposal and dual-gate authorities.

admission_gates: Identify the exact in-progress internal implementation repository/path, source commit and maturity state.
Verify the implementation's source depth, outputs, providers, tool boundaries and failure behavior against upstream.
Pin Siglary version, notation profile and adapter boundary; verify whether a stable enabled/disabled ablation exists.
Freeze eight matched public repositories and independent claim/requirement gold annotations.
Freeze blind scoring rubric, source-attribution rules, runner digest and configured-agent identity.
Validate design against DOE-TAXONOMY.md and docs/ops/corpus/EXPERIMENT.schema.json.
Implement tested automation and append-only record emission.
Run the complete randomized cohort and publish SUMMARY.json with uncertainty, missingness, cost and correctness gates.
promotion: Candidate remains not admitted until source identity, design, fixtures, automation and complete run evidence satisfy DoE family intake. Any promoted implementation pattern requires independent verification, provenance/license review and a new cohort/version record.
